title: VegX 3.0 – Vegetation Plot Exchange Standard
description: JSON Schema for exchanging vegetation plot (relevé) data. A dataset contains one or more self-contained projects, each with its metadata, shared definitions, and plotObservation records. Each plotObservation is the complete record of a single plot surveyed at a specific time: plot identity and location, observer and method metadata, user-defined stratum definitions, taxon occurrences by stratum, site observations, community type assignments, and broader community-level observations. This schema replaces the VegX 2.x XSD format; it covers the same information model with document-centric design rather than normalised ID references.

vegxVersion.description: Version of the VegX JSON schema used to create this file.

dataset.description: Container for one or more self-contained projects and provenance for generation of this VegX document.

projects.description: Research or monitoring projects contained in this dataset.

generatedBy.description: Ordered software operations that generated or transformed this dataset.

plotObservation.description: A single vegetation survey: the complete record of one plot observed at one point in time. This is the primary document unit.

plotObservationID.description: Globally unique identifier for this observation event, e.g. a UUID or LSID. Recommended for data exchange with national databases or GBIF.

obsEndDate.description: Date the observation ended, if it spans multiple days.

observers.description: People or organizations who carried out this survey.

license.description: License for this observation when different from the project-level license.

previousPlotObservationIDs.description: Stable plotObservationID values for earlier observations explicitly related to this observation. Usually unnecessary when the time series is clear from plotID and obsStartDate.

observationGroups.description: Named groupings to which this observation belongs because of a shared scientific or data-management characteristic.

strata.description: Observations of the vegetation layers recognised in this survey. Each entry keeps the layer definition separate from its measured properties. stratumID values are referenced by taxonObservation and organismObservation records within this plotObservation.

communityDeterminations.description: Assignments of this plot observation, or one of its strata, to vegetation community concepts. Multiple entries allow competing or revised classifications.

successionalStage.description: Successional stage of the vegetation at the time of observation, e.g. 'pioneer', 'early successional', 'late successional', 'climax', or 'post-fire regeneration'.

phenologicalStage.description: Seasonal phenological state of the vegetation at the time of observation, e.g. 'prevernal', 'vernal', 'estival', 'autumnal', or 'hibernal'.

physiognomy.description: Structural and life-form character of the vegetation, e.g. 'closed forest', 'open woodland', 'shrubland', 'grassland', 'heath', 'mire', or 'aquatic'.

taxonObservations.description: The core fact records of the relevé: each entry is one taxon in one stratum with a cover or abundance value. The same taxon may appear multiple times if it occurs in more than one stratum.

organismObservations.description: Observations of individually tagged or spatially mapped organisms, e.g. numbered trees in a permanent forest plot.

surfaceObservations.description: Cover observations for aggregate living or non-living surface categories such as total live plants, litter, bare rock, or open water. Supplements taxonObservations to allow total cover accounting without assigning aggregate cover to a taxon.

taxonomicCoverage.description: Assessment of identification status and survey completeness per taxon group. Equivalent to the VegX 2.x taxonomicQuality element.

identificationStatus.description: Whether and to what level this taxon group was identified, e.g. 'identified', 'partially identified', or 'not identified'. Free text or from a controlled vocabulary.

completeness.description: How completely the survey recorded this taxon group, e.g. 'complete', 'incomplete', or 'not surveyed'. Free text or from a controlled vocabulary.

observationConditions.description: Environmental conditions during the plot observation.

temperature.description: Air temperature during the observation. State the unit, normally degC or K.

weather.description: Weather during the observation, e.g. clear, overcast, light rain, or strong wind.

referencePublication.description: Original publication from which this plot observation was obtained, including its location within that publication.

table.description: Table containing the original plot record.

plot.description: Plot or releve number used in the publication.

section.description: Page, section, appendix, or other textual location in the publication.

observationGroup.description: A named grouping of observations sharing a scientific or data-management characteristic.

type.description: Kind of grouping, e.g. treatment, campaign, transect, vegetation table, or data batch.

identifier.description: An identifier together with the system that issued or interprets it and its uniqueness scope.

value.description: Identifier value, such as a local database key, UUID, DOI, or URI.

system.description: Identifier system, registry, or namespace, e.g. UUID, DOI, GBIF, or a database URI.

scope.description: document means unique only within this VegX document; system means unique within the stated identifier system.

notes.description: Comments or explanations, each with optional authorship and curation metadata.

generationEvent.description: A software operation that generated, exported, converted, or otherwise transformed this dataset.

softwareName.description: Name of the software that performed the operation, e.g. 'Vegapp for Android'.

softwareVersion.description: Version of the software, when known.

date.description: Date the operation was performed, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

softwareURL.description: URL identifying the software or its source repository.

note.description: A comment or explanation about the containing record.

date.description: Date the note was recorded, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

category.description: Purpose or audience of the note, e.g. observation, dataManagement, databaseUser, or internal.

plot.description: The physical sampling location. Properties assumed constant across observation events (location, geometry, area).

plotName.description: Name or alphanumeric code identifying this plot.

plotID.description: Globally unique identifier for this plot, e.g. a UUID or LSID. Should remain stable across resurveys — plotObservations share the same plotID as a time series and are sorted by obsStartDate.

geometry.description: Spatial representation of the plot as a GeoJSON Point, LineString, or Polygon. The GeoJSON type describes the available coordinates, not necessarily the physical plot shape; use geometryRole to state what the geometry represents. Default CRS is EPSG:4326 (geographic longitude/latitude on the WGS84 datum), as required by GeoJSON RFC 7946. Override with spatialReference if coordinates are in a different system.

spatialReference.description: EPSG code or Proj string of the CRS used for geometry coordinates, if not EPSG:4326. E.g. 'EPSG:28992' (Dutch RD New), 'EPSG:32632' (UTM zone 32N on WGS84 datum). Required whenever coordinates are not geographic longitude/latitude.

locationAccuracy.description: Estimated positional accuracy of the coordinates. State the unit.

area.description: Area of the plot. State the unit.

shape.description: Physical shape of the sampled plot, independent of the GeoJSON geometry type. For example, a square plot may be represented only by a Point centroid. A point plot has no sampled area and must not have area.

orientation.description: Bearing of the long axis of a rectangular or transect plot, clockwise from north. State the angular unit.

elevation.description: Preferred elevation of the plot. State the unit. Use locationRecords when preserving multiple determinations or their provenance.

locationRecords.description: Alternative or historical determinations of the plot coordinates or elevation. The top-level geometry and elevation remain the preferred values for routine use.

markers.description: Physical markers that help relocate the plot.

aquaticLocationRecords.description: Dated measurements locating an aquatic or marine plot relative to the water surface and nearest shore.

gridPositions.description: Positions in named survey or mapping grids.

authorLocation.description: Location wording recorded by the original author or source.

locationNarrative.description: Text useful for finding and relocating the plot in the field.

places.description: Named geographic places or regions containing the plot.

radius.description: Radius of a circular plot. State the unit.

width.description: Width of a rectangular or square plot. State the unit.

length.description: Length of a rectangular or linear plot. State the unit.

transectBandWidth.description: Distance from the transect axis to the edge of the sampled band. State the unit.

permanentPlot.description: True if the plot is permanently marked for repeat surveys.

placementMethod.description: Strategy used when siting the plot, e.g. 'random', 'stratified random', 'preferential', 'systematic grid'.

relatedPlots.description: Spatial relationships to other plots, e.g. parent plot, sub-plot.

relationship.description: Type of relationship from the perspective of the current plot, typically 'subplot' or 'parentPlot'.

relativePosition.description: Position of this plot relative to the origin and orientation of the related plot.

geometryRole.description: Role of a geometry in relation to the sampled plot. centroid is a representative centre point; origin is the zero point for relative coordinates; referencePoint is another known location; boundary is the sampled outline; axis is the centreline of a transect or linear plot.

locationRecord.description: A self-contained determination of plot coordinates, elevation, or both, including its provenance.

spatialReference.description: CRS of geometry; omit for EPSG:4326.

verticalDatum.description: Vertical reference for elevation, e.g. mean sea level, ellipsoid, or a named national datum.

position.description: Point represented within the plot, e.g. plot origin, centre, highest point, lowest point, or average.

sources.description: Maps, gazetteers, GPS files, imagery, or other resources used to determine the location.

preferred.description: True when this record supplies the preferred top-level geometry or elevation.

plotMarker.description: A physical marker used to relocate the plot.

markerType.description: Marker material or kind, e.g. magnetic marker, wooden peg, metal stake, or paint mark.

position.description: Position in or around the plot, e.g. south-west corner or centre.

aquaticLocationRecord.description: Location of an aquatic plot relative to the water surface and shore at a stated time.

position.description: Position represented by the depth, e.g. plot centre, shallowest point, or average.

placeType.description: Kind of place, e.g. country, administrative region, protected area, or municipality.

placeScheme.description: Vocabulary or gazetteer from which the place was taken, e.g. ISO 3166 or GeoNames.

placeID.description: Identifier or URI for the place in the stated scheme.

plotOrigin.description: The point within the plot from which relative coordinates are measured. Its absolute coordinates may be supplied by geometry with geometryRole origin or by a locationRecord.

position.description: Position of the origin, e.g. centre, south-west corner, or permanent marker.

relativePlotPosition.description: Cartesian offset from the related plot's origin, with axes defined by the related plot's orientation.

stratumDefinition.description: Definition of a vegetation layer, independent of what was observed in that layer during a particular survey.

name.description: Name of the layer, e.g. 'upper tree layer', 'shrub layer', 'herb layer', or 'bryophyte layer'.

description.description: Rule defining which vegetation belongs to this layer, e.g. 'Trees between 5 and 20 m height'.

order.description: Position in the ordered sequence of strata; 1 = tallest.

heightRange.description: Definitional height limits. These are vocabulary boundaries, not heights measured during the survey.

method.description: Method or published scheme used to define this layer.

stratumObservation.description: Properties observed for one defined vegetation layer during this plot survey.

stratumID.description: Short code referenced by other records in this plot observation, e.g. 'T1', 'S', 'H', or 'M'.

heightMin.description: Lowest observed height of this layer. State the unit.

heightMax.description: Highest observed height of this layer. State the unit.

coverValue.description: Total cover or abundance of this layer as recorded in the field. Use a numeric value with unit % for direct percentage cover, or a string value with coverScale for a coded scale. This is distinct from the cover of individual taxa within the layer.

attributes.description: Other measured properties of this layer beyond cover, e.g. leaf area index or stem count.

taxonObservation.description: Record of one taxon observed in one stratum with a cover or abundance value. The same taxon may appear multiple times in a plot observation if it occupies more than one stratum.

stratumID.description: References a stratumID defined in the strata array of this plotObservation. Omit for surveys that do not distinguish strata.

coverValue.description: Cover or abundance value as recorded in the field. Use a string value for ordinal codes such as 'r', '+', '1', '2a', '2b', '3', '4', or '5' (Braun-Blanquet), and a numeric value for percentages or counts.

attributes.description: Additional attributes for this taxon in this stratum, beyond cover. E.g. mean height, frequency, basal area, stem count, biomass, vitality class. Equivalent to VegX aggregateOrganismMeasurement and taxonObservation attributes.

organismObservation.description: Dated observation of a single, individually identifiable organism such as a numbered tree in a permanent plot. Repeat organismID in later plot observations to build a time series without a separate individual-organism registry.

organismID.description: Stable identifier for this individual, repeated unchanged across resurveys. It must be unique within the dataset; use a globally unique URI or UUID when records will be exchanged independently. This is an identity value, not a reference to another object.

tagLabel.description: Physical identification label attached to the individual, e.g. a tree tag number. Unlike organismID, a tag may be replaced or renumbered.

birthDate.description: Known or estimated date of establishment, germination, or birth. Repeat the same value across resurveys when supplied.

relatedOrganisms.description: Direct biological or physical relationships to other persistent individuals, e.g. fused stems, an epiphyte and its host, or paired individuals.

stratumID.description: Stratum this individual belongs to, referencing strata in this plotObservation.

location.description: Position of this individual. Provide whichever coordinate type(s) the survey protocol uses; all fields are optional and multiple systems may be recorded simultaneously.

geometry.description: Absolute georeferenced position as a GeoJSON Point, e.g. from a GPS fix. To record the positioning instrument (e.g. 'Garmin GPSMAP 66i', 'total station', 'dGPS'), add an attribute with attributeType 'geometryMethod'.

spatialReference.description: EPSG code or Proj string of the CRS for the absolute geometry, if not EPSG:4326. E.g. 'EPSG:28992' (Dutch RD New), 'EPSG:32632' (UTM zone 32N).

locationAccuracy.description: Estimated positional accuracy. State the unit.

plotX.description: Cartesian X offset from the plot origin, typically a south-west corner or marked reference point. State the unit.

plotY.description: Cartesian Y offset from the plot origin. State the unit.

transectPosition.description: Distance along the transect axis from the transect start, for one-dimensional belt transect surveys. State the unit.

distanceFromOrigin.description: Radial distance from a defined reference point. State the unit. Use with bearingFromOrigin for polar coordinates, or with quarter for Point-Centred Quarter Method.

bearingFromOrigin.description: Bearing clockwise from north to this individual, measured from the plot origin (polar coordinates). State the angular unit. Use with distanceFromOrigin.

quarter.description: Quarter in which this individual was found, for Point-Centred Quarter Method (PCQM). The area around each sample point is divided into four 90° quadrants: NE, NW, SE, SW. Use with distanceFromOrigin for the distance to the nearest individual in that quarter.

attributes.description: Further positional attributes or method qualifiers for this individual's location, e.g. positioning instrument, coordinate precision class.
Attributes of this individual, e.g. diameter at breast height (DBH, ratio), total height (ratio), crown diameter (ratio), growth form (nominal), vitality class (ordinal).

organismRelationship.description: A direct relationship from the observed individual to another individual identified by its stable organismID.

relatedOrganismID.description: organismID of the related individual. The related individual may occur in the same or another plot observation in this dataset.

relationship.description: Relationship from the perspective of the observed individual, e.g. 'fusedWith', 'epiphyteOn', 'hostOf', 'offspringOf', or 'pairedWith'.

taxonNameType.description: Nature of the taxonName label. Omit when it is an ordinary scientific name.

taxonDeterminations.description: Original and subsequent taxonomic or nomenclatural determinations of an occurrence. All determinations use the same self-contained structure.

originalDetermination.description: Determination attached to the occurrence when it was originally recorded.

subsequentDeterminations.description: Later identifications or nomenclatural revisions, ordered from oldest to newest.

taxonDetermination.description: An original or later identification or nomenclatural interpretation of an observed taxon. Each determination contains its own name, references, provenance, and assessment.

taxonName.description: Taxon name assigned by this determination, including author citation when available.

taxonID.description: URI or identifier resolving to the taxon concept assigned by this determination.

taxonConceptReference.description: Taxonomic treatment defining the circumscription used in this determination. Do not use a nomenclatural checklist here unless it also defines that circumscription.

nameReference.description: Nomenclatural source or reference list supporting the determined name's spelling, authorship, synonymy, or accepted-name status without implying that it defines a taxon concept.

determinationDate.description: Date this determination or nomenclatural revision was made.

determinedBy.description: People or organizations responsible for this determination.

vouchers.description: Voucher specimen identifiers or herbarium accession numbers supporting this determination.

fit.description: Degree to which the observed organism fits the assigned taxon concept, using a stated or commonly understood scale.

confidence.description: Confidence in this determination, e.g. 'high', 'moderate', or 'low'.

accordingTo.description: Publication or treatment whose taxonomic or nomenclatural view is followed.

preferred.description: True when this is the currently recommended interpretation of the occurrence. At most one determination should be preferred.

surfaceTypeDefinition.description: Definition of an aggregate living or non-living surface category, independent of its observed cover.

name.description: Name of the surface category, e.g. 'litter', 'bare rock', 'open water', or 'fallen dead wood'.

description.description: Rule defining what belongs to this surface category.

method.description: Method or published scheme used to define this surface category.

surfaceObservation.description: Cover observation for an aggregate living or non-living surface category. Supplements taxonObservations to allow full cover accounting.

coverValue.description: Recorded surface cover or abundance. Use a numeric value with unit % for direct percentage cover, or a string value with coverScale for a coded scale.

attributes.description: Additional attributes of this surface element, e.g. litter depth (ratio), water depth (ratio), rock roughness class (ordinal).

communityConcept.description: A named vegetation community concept, preferably anchored to a published classification.

name.description: Name of the plant community type, e.g. 'Luzulo-Fagetum Meusel 1937', 'W10 Quercus robur – Pteridium aquilinum woodland' (NVC).

code.description: Code for this community concept within its classification system.

conceptID.description: Identifier or URI for this community concept, e.g. an EuroVegChecklist or EUNIS URI.

rank.description: Rank in the community classification, e.g. class, order, alliance, association, or subassociation.

commonName.description: Vernacular or descriptive name for the community concept.

reference.description: Publication or classification that defines this community concept.

communityDetermination.description: An assignment of a vegetation community concept to a plot observation or one of its strata.

stratumID.description: stratumID to which this determination applies. Omit when it applies to the plot observation as a whole.

determinedBy.description: People or organizations responsible for this determination.

fit.description: Degree to which the observed vegetation fits the assigned community concept.

confidence.description: Confidence in this determination, e.g. 'high', 'moderate', or 'low'.

accordingTo.description: Authority, publication, or treatment whose interpretation of the community concept is followed in this assertion.

siteObservations.description: Abiotic, land-use, protection, and habitat characteristics of the plot site as observed during the survey. Named fields cover commonly recorded properties; domain-specific measurement arrays and classifications preserve the broader site information model.

soilMeasurements.description: Arbitrary measurements of soil chemistry, texture, structure, moisture, or other soil properties not represented by a named field.

climateMeasurements.description: Arbitrary climatic measurements or summaries applying to the plot, e.g. annual precipitation, temperature normals, or frost-free period.

waterBodyMeasurements.description: Arbitrary measurements of a water body within the plot, e.g. water level, conductivity, or water chemistry. Soil-water measurements belong in soilMeasurements.

aspectCategorical.description: Compass direction the slope faces. Use cardinal/intercardinal notation such as 'N', 'NE', or 'NNE'.

aspect.description: Slope aspect as a bearing clockwise from north. State the angular unit. Use as an alternative to or alongside aspectCategorical.

slope.description: Slope inclination. State the angular unit.

topographicPosition.description: Position in the landscape, e.g. 'ridge', 'upper slope', 'mid slope', 'lower slope', 'valley bottom', 'flat plain', or 'depression'.

microrelief.description: Description of small-scale surface relief within the plot, e.g. 'hummock-hollow' or 'flat'.

soilType.description: Soil type name within the classification system specified in soilTypeSystem, e.g. 'Cambisol', 'Entisol', or 'Podzol'.

soilTypeSystem.description: Soil classification system used for soilType, e.g. 'WRB' (IUSS World Reference Base), 'USDA' (Soil Taxonomy), 'FAO 1990', 'national legend'.

soilpH.description: Topsoil pH. Record the suspension medium and sampled depth in samplingContext because both materially affect comparison between datasets.

soilTexture.description: Texture class of the topsoil, e.g. 'sand', 'loamy sand', 'sandy loam', 'loam', 'silt loam', 'clay loam', or 'clay'.

soilDepth.description: Depth to bedrock or an impermeable layer. State the unit.

geology.description: Dominant bedrock or parent material, e.g. 'granite', 'limestone', 'fluvial sand', or 'loess'.

climateTypes.description: Climate classifications applying to the plot, with their classification schemes when known.

hydrologicRegimes.description: Classifications of the frequency and duration of water-level variation at the plot.

legalProtections.description: Legal protection statuses applying to the plot at the time of observation.

landUses.description: Current land-use classifications applying to the plot, e.g. pasture, forestry, recreation, or no active use.

habitats.description: Habitat classifications assigned to the plot, potentially from multiple classification schemes.

landUseHistory.description: Relevant prior land use, e.g. 'formerly arable', 'regularly mown meadow', 'coppiced', or 'planted forest'.

disturbance.description: Recent or ongoing disturbance events or regime, e.g. 'burnt May 2022', 'cattle grazed', or 'storm damage 2019'.

attributes.description: Further site attributes not covered by the named fields, e.g. LAI, groundwater depth.

siteClassification.description: A qualitative site classification, optionally anchored to a controlled vocabulary or published classification scheme.

value.description: Category name or code assigned to the site.

scheme.description: Name of the classification system or controlled vocabulary, e.g. Koppen-Geiger, EUNIS, Ramsar, or a national protection scheme.

conceptID.description: Identifier or URI for this category within the stated scheme.

measurement.description: Shared structure for a recorded or assessed value, including its property name when needed, unit, uncertainty, method, date, and sampling context.

attributeType.description: Name or identifier of the measured property. Required for arbitrary attributes and omitted when the containing VegX property supplies the meaning.

value.description: Recorded value. Use a number for quantitative values and a string for categories or field codes.

method.description: Instrument, procedure, or assessment method used to obtain the value, e.g. 'visual estimate of projected cover'. For a coded cover value, record the cover scale separately in the coverValue's coverScale property rather than using its name as the method.

observationDate.description: Date this value was recorded, if different from the plot observation date.

observedValue.description: A measurement of a predefined VegX property. The containing property supplies the meaning, so attributeType is not permitted.

coverObservedValue.description: A cover or abundance measurement. A coded string value carries its interpreting scale in the same object; a direct numeric percentage uses unit % and omits coverScale.

value.description: Recorded cover or abundance value. Use a string for a coded scale value and a number for direct percentages or counts.

method.description: Instrument, procedure, or assessment method used to obtain the cover value, e.g. 'Visual estimate'.

coverScale.description: Name of the coded cover or abundance scale interpreting value. Should match a scaleName defined in the containing project's coverScales. Omit for direct numeric percentages represented with unit %.

observationDate.description: Date this value was recorded, if different from the plot observation date.

samplingContext.description: Context defining where or in what medium a value was obtained, especially for soil and water measurements.

unit.description: Unit applying to depthMinimum and depthMaximum.

medium.description: Preparation or suspension medium, e.g. 'H2O 1:2.5', 'CaCl2 0.01M 1:2.5', or 'KCl 1M 1:2.5'.

position.description: Position represented by the value, e.g. 'plot centre', 'highest point', or 'plot origin'.

attribute.description: A measurement of an arbitrary named property. It uses the shared measurement structure and requires attributeType because the containing array does not supply the property meaning.

attributeGroups.description: Named sets of measurements that must be interpreted together, e.g. crown length and width or the dimensions used to calculate volume.

attributeGroup.description: A self-contained tuple of related measurements. Measurements are nested directly to avoid tuple-membership IDs.

groupName.description: Name of the combined quantity or relationship, e.g. 'crownDimensions', 'stemDiameterAtHeight', or 'volumeDimensions'.

attributes.description: Two or more measurements belonging to this tuple.

method.description: Method applying to the group as a whole.

extensions.description: Non-standard information not represented by a VegX property. Extensions must use a stable namespace so independently developed terms do not collide. Prefer standard VegX properties whenever they exist.

extension.description: A namespaced extension value. The namespace owner defines the meaning and expected JSON shape of value.

namespace.description: Stable URI identifying the organization or vocabulary that defines this extension, e.g. 'https://example.org/vegetation/terms/'. It need not resolve over the network.

name.description: Local extension term within the namespace, e.g. 'canopyPhoto'.

value.description: Extension content. May be a JSON string, number, boolean, object, array, or null.

schema.description: Optional URI of a JSON Schema or documentation defining the value.

coverScale.description: Definition of a named coded cover or abundance scale. Defines the mapping from ordinal field codes to percentage cover ranges, enabling quantitative conversion and cross-dataset comparison.

scaleName.description: Name used for this scale in the dataset, including a variant or edition qualifier when known, e.g. 'Braun-Blanquet (new)', 'Domin', 'DAFOR', 'van der Maarel', or 'Hult-Sernander-Du Rietz'.

reference.description: Published source or other documentation defining this scale or variant. Recommended when known; omit when the exact source cannot be established, as may be the case for legacy data.

values.description: Ordered list of scale values from lowest to highest abundance.

code.description: The code as used in the field, e.g. 'r', '+', '1', '2a', '2b', '3', '4', '5' for Braun-Blanquet.

coverMin_pct.description: Lower bound of cover percentage for this code.

coverMax_pct.description: Upper bound of cover percentage for this code.

coverMidpoint_pct.description: Conventional midpoint percentage used when converting to quantitative cover, e.g. for ordination or averaging.

party.description: A person, organization, or position and its contact details.

name.description: Full name of the person or organization.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier without the https://orcid.org/ prefix, e.g. '0000-0001-2345-6789'.

affiliation.description: Institution or organization with which a person is affiliated.

position.description: Title or position associated with this party.

license.description: License and attribution information applying to a dataset or plot observation.

licenseName.description: License name or SPDX identifier, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, CC0-1.0, or All rights reserved.

attribution.description: Credit or preferred citation, including original authors and funding sources where appropriate.

project.description: Self-contained research or monitoring project, including its metadata, shared definitions, and plot observations.

projectName.description: Name or title of the project.

projectID.description: Unique identifier, e.g. a GBIF dataset key, DOI, or national database code.

abstract.description: Brief description of the aims and findings of the project.

personnel.description: People or organizations involved in the project. Each party's role describes its involvement.

studyAreaDescription.description: Physical study area, potentially including coverage, climate, geology, and disturbance history.

designDescription.description: Research design, especially the overall plot placement design.

methods.description: Survey methods shared by observations in this project. Methods applying to only one observation may instead be embedded there.

protocols.description: Protocols grouping methods used in this project.

coverScales.description: Definitions of coded cover or abundance scales used in this project. Referenced by name (coverScale) from taxonObservation or stratumObservation records. Include each named coded scale used by the project. Direct numeric percentages are self-describing through coverValue with unit % and do not need a coverScale definition.

plotObservations.description: Plot observation records belonging to this project. Repeat a complete observation in each project when it belongs to multiple projects, preserving the same stable plotObservationID when available.

method.description: A method used to measure a parameter or create part of the dataset.

name.description: Name of the method, e.g. 'Braun-Blanquet relevé', 'point-intercept transect'.

subject.description: Attribute class measured by this method, e.g. 'plant cover', allowing results from comparable methods to be combined.

protocol.description: An agreed protocol grouping methods related by a common action.

responsibleParty.description: Party responsible for describing the protocol; role describes their involvement.

methods.description: Ordered methods or steps comprising this protocol.

citationString.description: Full citation as a formatted string, e.g. 'Braun-Blanquet, J. (1964). Pflanzensoziologie. 3rd ed. Springer, Vienna.'

doi.description: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix, e.g. '10.1007/s12080-012-0168-7'.

url.description: URL of the resource if no DOI is available.

accessDate.description: Date the URL was last accessed, ISO 8601 (yyyy-mm-dd). Required when citing web resources without a DOI.

csl.description: Structured citation encoded as one CSL-JSON item. Use when bibliographic detail beyond the lightweight fields above is needed.

geoJsonGeometry.description: A GeoJSON geometry representing the location or boundary of the plot. Default CRS is EPSG:4326 (geographic longitude/latitude, WGS84 datum) per GeoJSON RFC 7946. Override with spatialReference when using projected coordinates. Supports Point (centroid or GPS fix), LineString (transect axis), and Polygon (plot boundary).

coordinates.description: Ordered sequence of positions defining the transect or plot boundary line. Each position is [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation].
Array of linear rings. First ring is the exterior boundary; additional rings are holes. Each ring must have at least 4 positions with first and last position identical.
